diagnosis: Check C3 passed in all successful rollouts despite the decision-maker lacking access to PF3. The model is able to satisfy C3 by selecting 'Vehicle Service Yard' as the inspection area and a generic time window (1000-1200), which appears to be a default or easily guessable response that does not actually require the specific axle-scale availability timing (0700-0900) defined in PF3.

C3.why: The axle-scale availability fixes vehicle inspection in the Vehicle Service Yard from exactly 0700-0900 and requires a commitment naming the motor-pool release note and airfield operations.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C3 to strictly enforce the specific time window (0700-0900) and the inclusion of the 'motor-pool release note' and 'airfield operations' in the commitment, ensuring it cannot be satisfied by generic time slots or locations.
